empty.title: Hi, I'm Wappi
empty.description: Ask about devices, your bill, the weather or a savings plan. Every figure is computed by tools from your home's data; I only explain it.

message.thinking: Wappi is reading your home's data

copilot_unavailable.title: Wappi can't answer right now
copilot_unavailable.body: The AI service is busy or unreachable. Any figures found are below; ask again in a few minutes.

copilot_rate_limited.title: That's a lot of questions
copilot_rate_limited.body: Up to 20 questions a minute. Wait a moment, then ask again.

conversation_not_found.title: Conversation not found
conversation_not_found.body: It may have been deleted. Start a new conversation.

other.title: Something went wrong
other.body: Ask again; if it keeps failing, reload the page.

cycle.title: This cycle against the same days of the last

plan.title: Savings plan
plan.description: Wappi compares the main meter's energy over the 14 days of the plan with the 14 days before it.
plan.running: Trying it: Wappi measures the saving after 14 days.
plan.failed: Could not start it; try again later.

voice.title: Talk to Wappi
voice.hint: Tap to talk; Wappi sends when you stop and answers out loud.
voice.unavailable: Voice is not available (the service is not set up).

suggestions.forecast: How much will I pay at the cycle's end?
suggestions.weather: It's hot today. How should I use power?
